<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project>
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
    <artifactId>DDS2-jClient-JForex</artifactId>
    <version>3.6.34</version>
    <name>DDS2-JClient-JForex</name>
    <description>DUKASCOPY client application</description>
    <organization>
        <name>DUKASCOPY Bank(Suisse) SA</name>
        <url>http://www.dukascopy.com</url>
    </organization>
    <scm>
        <connection>
         	scm:git:https://bitbucket.site.dukascopy.com/scm/jforex/jclient.git
        </connection>
    </scm>
    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8
        </project.build.sourceEncoding>
    </properties>
    <build>
        <sourceDirectory>src</sourceDirectory>
        <testSourceDirectory>test</testSourceDirectory>
        <testResources>
            <testResource>
                <directory>test</directory>
            </testResource>
        </testResources>
        <resources>
            <resource>
                <targetPath>rc</targetPath>
                <directory>rc</directory>
                <excludes>
                	<exclude>log4j.xml</exclude>
                </excludes>
            </resource>
            <resource>
                <directory>rc</directory>
                <targetPath>./</targetPath>
                <includes>
                	<include>log4j.xml</include>
                </includes>
            </resource>
        </resources>
        <plugins>
 			<plugin>
				<artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.8.0</version>
				<inherited>true</inherited>
				<configuration>
					<source>8</source>
					<target>8</target>
					<fork>true</fork>
					<encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-assembly-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>ordergridplugin</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <attach>false</attach>
                            <outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/rc/plugins</outputDirectory>
                            <finalName>OrderGridPlugin</finalName>
                            <descriptors>
                                <descriptor>resources/plugins/ordergridplugin-assembly.xml</descriptor>
                            </descriptors>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                    <execution>
                        <id>ordersmirrorplugin</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <attach>false</attach>
                            <outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/rc/plugins</outputDirectory>
                            <finalName>OrdersMirrorPlugin</finalName>
                            <descriptors>
                                <descriptor>resources/plugins/ordersmirrorplugin-assembly.xml</descriptor>
                            </descriptors>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                    <execution>
                        <id>ordersremoveplugin</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <attach>false</attach>
                            <outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/rc/plugins</outputDirectory>
                            <finalName>OrdersRemovePlugin</finalName>
                            <descriptors>
                                <descriptor>resources/plugins/ordersremoveplugin-assembly.xml</descriptor>
                            </descriptors>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
 			<plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>2.3.2</version>
                <inherited>true</inherited>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>instantorderplugin</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <finalName>InstantOrderPlugin</finalName>
                            <outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/rc/plugins/</outputDirectory>
                            <includes>
                                <include>com/dukascopy/dds2/greed/gui/plugins/instant/</include>
                            </includes>
                            <archive>
                                <index>true</index>
                                <manifestEntries>
                                    <Application-Name>Instant Order</Application-Name>
                                    <pluginMainClass>com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.gui.plugins.instant.InstantOrderPlugin</pluginMainClass>
                                </manifestEntries>
                            </archive>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                    <!--<execution>
                        <id>crossingstrategywizard</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <finalName>CrossingStrategyWizard</finalName>
                            <outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/rc/plugins/</outputDirectory>
                            <includes>
                                <include>com/dukascopy/dds2/greed/gui/plugins/strategywizard/</include>
                            </includes>
                            <archive>
                                <index>true</index>
                                <manifestEntries>
                                    <Application-Name>Crossing Strategy Wizard</Application-Name>
                                    <pluginMainClass>com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.gui.plugins.strategywizard.CrossingStrategyWizard</pluginMainClass>
                                </manifestEntries>
                            </archive>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>-->
                    <execution>
                        <id>default-jar</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <archive>
                                <index>true</index>
                                <manifest>
                                    <addDefaultImplementationEntries>true</addDefaultImplementationEntries>
                                    <mainClass>com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.GreedClient</mainClass>
                                </manifest>
                                <manifestEntries>
                                    <Permissions>all-permissions</Permissions>
                                    <Codebase>*</Codebase>
                                    <Application-Name>JForex Client</Application-Name>
                                </manifestEntries>
                            </archive>
                            <excludes>
                                <exclude>com/dukascopy/dds2/greed/gui/plugin/instant/</exclude>
                                <!--<exclude>com/dukascopy/dds2/greed/gui/plugins/strategywizard/</exclude>-->
                            </excludes>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

            <!--called each time when maven is started-->
            <!--to call run "mvn clean install -DskipTests" and see results at the end of maven output-->

                        <!--<suppressionFile>project-suppression.xml</suppressionFile>-->

                        <!--<goals>-->

                <!--</executions>-->
            <!--</plugin>-->
            
        </plugins>
        <pluginManagement>
        	<plugins>
        		<!--This plugin's configuration is used to store Eclipse m2e settings only. It has no influence on the Maven build itself.-->
        		<plugin>
        			<groupId>org.eclipse.m2e</groupId>
        			<artifactId>lifecycle-mapping</artifactId>
        			<version>1.0.0</version>
        			<configuration>
        				<lifecycleMappingMetadata>
        					<pluginExecutions>
        						<pluginExecution>
        							<pluginExecutionFilter>
        								<groupId>
        									org.apache.maven.plugins
        								</groupId>
        								<artifactId>
        									maven-dependency-plugin
        								</artifactId>
        								<versionRange>
        									[2.4,)
        								</versionRange>
        								<goals>
        									<goal>
        										unpack-dependencies
        									</goal>
        								</goals>
        							</pluginExecutionFilter>
        							<action>
        								<ignore></ignore>
        							</action>
        						</pluginExecution>
        						<pluginExecution>
        							<pluginExecutionFilter>
        								<groupId>
        									org.apache.maven.plugins
        								</groupId>
        								<artifactId>
        									maven-antrun-plugin
        								</artifactId>
        								<versionRange>
        									[1.7,)
        								</versionRange>
        								<goals>
        									<goal>run</goal>
        								</goals>
        							</pluginExecutionFilter>
        							<action>
        								<ignore></ignore>
        							</action>
        						</pluginExecution>
        					</pluginExecutions>
        				</lifecycleMappingMetadata>
        			</configuration>
        		</plugin>
        	</plugins>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
    <distributionManagement>
        <repository>
            <id>dukascopy</id>
            <name>Dukascopy releases</name>
            <url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy</url>
        </repository>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>dukascopy</id>
            <name>Dukascopy snapshots</name>
            <url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy-snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
    </distributionManagement>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.api</groupId>
            <artifactId>JForex-API</artifactId>
            <version>2.13.98</version>
			<classifier>sources</classifier>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
            <artifactId>DDS2-Charts</artifactId>
            <version>6.24.113</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.fife</groupId>
            <artifactId>DDS2-TextEditor</artifactId>
            <version>1.27.98</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
            <artifactId>ui-core</artifactId>
            <version>1.6.102</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.4.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-highlighter</artifactId>
            <version>3.4.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>ta-lib</groupId>
            <artifactId>ta-lib</artifactId>
            <version>0.4.4dc</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>junit</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
            <version>4.12</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
		    <groupId>com.googlecode.jmockit</groupId>
		    <artifactId>jmockit</artifactId>
		    <version>1.7</version>
		    <scope>test</scope>
		</dependency>
        
        <dependency>
			<groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
			<artifactId>slf4j-log4j12</artifactId>
			<version>1.7.28</version>
			<optional>false</optional>
		</dependency>
         <dependency>
    		<groupId>javax.jnlp</groupId>
    		<artifactId>jnlp-api</artifactId>
    		<version>7.0</version>
    		<scope>system</scope>
            <optional>true</optional>
    		<systemPath>${java.home}/lib/javaws.jar</systemPath>
		</dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy.docking.framework</groupId>
            <artifactId>CleanDocking</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.15</version>
        </dependency>
		<dependency>
    		<groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
    		<artifactId>Login-Form</artifactId>
    		<version>3.31</version>
		</dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <!-- Run with maven -Pjforex-webstart parameter to activate this 
                profile -->
            <id>jforex-webstart</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                        <artifactId>webstart-maven-plugin</artifactId>
						<version>1.0-beta-7</version>
						<dependencies>
							<dependency>
								<groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
								<artifactId>keytool-api-1.7</artifactId>
								<version>1.5</version>
							</dependency>
						</dependencies>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>test</id>
                                <phase>package</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jnlp-inline</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <codebase>${jnlpCodebase}</codebase>
                                    <resourcesDirectory>
                                        ${project.basedir}/resources/webstart
                                    </resourcesDirectory>
                                    <jnlp>
                                        <inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                            ${project.basedir}
                                        </inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                        <inputTemplate>
                                            resources/templates/test.vm
                                        </inputTemplate>
                                        <outputFile>
                                            jforex-test.jnlp
                                        </outputFile>
                                        <mainClass>
                                            com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.GreedClient
                                        </mainClass>
                                    </jnlp>
                                    <sign>
                                        <keystore>
                                            ${project.basedir}/security/mainKeystore
                                        </keystore>
                                        <keypass>dukascopy</keypass>
                                        <storepass>dukascopy</storepass>
                                        <alias>dukascopy</alias>
                                    </sign>
                                    <pack200><enabled>false</enabled></pack200>
                                    <gzip>false</gzip>
                                    <outputJarVersions>false</outputJarVersions>
                                    <attachArchive>false</attachArchive>
                                    <verbose>false</verbose>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                            <execution>
                                <id>predemo</id>
                                <phase>package</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jnlp-single</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <codebase>${jnlpCodebase}</codebase>
                                    <resourcesDirectory>
                                        ${project.basedir}/resources/webstart
                                    </resourcesDirectory>
                                    <jnlp>
                                        <inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                            ${project.basedir}
                                        </inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                        <inputTemplate>
                                            resources/templates/predemo.vm
                                        </inputTemplate>
                                        <outputFile>
                                            jforex-predemo.jnlp
                                        </outputFile>
                                        <mainClass>
                                            com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.GreedClient
                                        </mainClass>
                                    </jnlp>
                                    <verbose>false</verbose>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                            <execution>
                                <id>demo</id>
                                <phase>package</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jnlp-single</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <codebase>${jnlpCodebase}</codebase>
                                    <resourcesDirectory>
                                        ${project.basedir}/resources/webstart
                                    </resourcesDirectory>
                                    <jnlp>
                                        <inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                            ${project.basedir}
                                        </inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                        <inputTemplate>
                                            resources/templates/demo.vm
                                        </inputTemplate>
                                        <outputFile>
                                            jforex-demo.jnlp
                                        </outputFile>
                                        <mainClass>
                                            com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.GreedClient
                                        </mainClass>
                                    </jnlp>
                                    <verbose>false</verbose>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                            <execution>
                                <id>live</id>
                                <phase>package</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jnlp-single</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <codebase>${jnlpCodebase}</codebase>
                                    <resourcesDirectory>
                                        ${project.basedir}/resources/webstart
                                    </resourcesDirectory>
                                    <jnlp>
                                        <inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                            ${project.basedir}
                                        </inputTemplateResourcePath>
                                        <inputTemplate>
                                            resources/templates/live.vm
                                        </inputTemplate>
                                        <outputFile>
                                            jforex-live.jnlp
                                        </outputFile>
                                        <mainClass>
                                            com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.GreedClient
                                        </mainClass>
                                    </jnlp>
                                    <verbose>false</verbose>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-antrun-plugin</artifactId>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>ftp</id>
                                <phase>deploy</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>run</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <target>
                                        <property
                                            file="${basedir}/../ftp.properties" />
                                        <ftp action="del"
                                            server="${ftp.server}"
                                            remotedir="${remote.dir}"
                                            userid="${user}" password="${password}"
                                            verbose="yes">
                                            <fileset>
                                                <include name="**/*" />
                                            </fileset>
                                        </ftp>
                                        <ftp action="send"
                                            server="${ftp.server}"
                                            remotedir="${remote.dir}"
                                            userid="${user}" password="${password}"
                                            verbose="yes">
                                            <fileset dir="./target/jnlp/">
                                            </fileset>
                                        </ftp>
                                    </target>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                        <dependencies>
                            <dependency>
                                <groupId>org.apache.ant</groupId>
                                <artifactId>ant-commons-net</artifactId>
                                <version>1.7.1</version>
                            </dependency>
                            <dependency>
                                <groupId>commons-net</groupId>
                                <artifactId>commons-net</artifactId>
                                <version>3.1</version>
                            </dependency>
                        </dependencies>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <!-- Run with maven -Pjforex-webstart parameter to activate this 
                profile -->
            <!-- demo differs with obfuscation -->
            <id>jforex-webstart-demo</id>

            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>com.pyx4me</groupId>
                        <artifactId>proguard-maven-plugin</artifactId>
						<version>2.0.4</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <phase>package</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>proguard</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                        <configuration>
                            <proguardVersion>5.1.3</proguardVersion>
                            <assembly>
                                <inclusions>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>greed-common</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!**log4j.xml,!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds4</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>netty-transport-client</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>msg</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>DDS2-Charts</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
				    				<inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>patterns</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!**log4j.xml,!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds4</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>transport-common</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>transport-core</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>Login-Form</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>ui-core</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.docking.framework</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>CleanDocking</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>auth-protocol-client</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>org.fife</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>DDS2-TextEditor</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>com.dukascopy.holiday</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>holiday-common</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                                    <inclusion>
                                        <groupId>org.threeten</groupId>
                                        <artifactId>threeten-extra</artifactId>
                                        <filter>!META-INF/INDEX.LIST</filter>
                                    </inclusion>
                               </inclusions>
                            </assembly>
                            <options>
                            	<option>
                            		-ignorewarnings
                            	</option>
                                <!-- Optimization fails in current version -->
                                <option>
                                    -dontoptimize
                                </option>
                                <!-- Needed for setLength(int) in StringBuilder, 
                                    because it's in package visible abstract class -->
                                <option>
                                    -dontskipnonpubliclibraryclasses
                                </option>
                                <option>
                                    -useuniqueclassmembernames
                                </option>
                                <option>
                                    -dontusemixedcaseclassnames
                                </option>
                                <!-- Prevalidate for Java 1.7 
                                <option>
                                    -target 1.7
                                </option>
                                -->
                                <!-- Prevalidate for Java 1.6 -->
                                <option>
                                    -target 1.8
                                </option>
                                
                                <!-- MBeans -->
                                <option>
                                    -keep class **MBean
                                </option>
                                <!-- MBean implementations -->
                                <option>
                                    -keep class * extends **MBean
                                </option>
                                <!-- DDSAgent -->
                                <option>
                                    -keepclassmembers class *
                                    extends
                                    com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.agent.IDDSAgent
                                    {
                                    public <methods>;
                                    }
                                </option>
                                <option>
                                    -keepclassmembers class
                                    com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.agent.strategy.tester.TesterCustodian
                                    {
                                    *** submitOrderImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    addOrderSubmittedReportData(...);
                                    *** closeOrderImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    addOrderClosedReportData(...);
                                    ***
                                    cancelOrderImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    addOrderCanceledReportData(...);
                                    ***
                                    mergeOrdersImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    addOrderChangedReportData(...);
                                    ***
                                    setStopLossImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    changeAmountImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    changeOpenPriceImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    setTakeProfitImpl(...);
                                    ***
                                    setGoodTillTimeImpl(...);
                                    }
                                </option>
                                <!-- macos handlers -->
                                <option>
                                    -keepclassmembers class
                                    com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.gui.component.menu.MainMenu
                                    {
                                    *** quit(...);
                                    *** about(...);
                                    *** preferences(...);
                                    }
                                </option>
                                <option>
                                    -keepclass class
                                    com.dukascopy.dds2.greed.gui.component.menu.osx.BaseOSXAdapter
